groups.title: MCP Tasks Conformance
groups.summary: 2/14 checks passed, 0 failed, 0 could not run, 12 not applicable

cases.title: Tasks Wire Resolvable
cases.description: The negotiated protocol version and advertised capabilities resolve to exactly one tasks wire.

cases.title: Per-Version Declaration Hygiene
cases.description: Outgoing requests carry `params.task` only on the legacy wire and the tasks extension declaration only on the extension wire; a connection with no tasks wire sends neither.

cases.title: Result Type Discipline
cases.description: A task-eligible tools/call returns either a normal tool result or a flat CreateTaskResult with resultType "task" and a server-generated taskId.
cases.error: connection resolves to no tasks wire, so there is no task behavior to probe

cases.title: Undeclared Task Creation Refused
cases.description: On the extension wire, a tools/call that did not carry the extension declaration must not come back as a CreateTaskResult: the server either answers normally or rejects with -32021.
cases.error: check applies to the extension wire only

cases.title: Undeclared Capability Rejected
cases.description: tasks/get, tasks/update, tasks/cancel and a task-filtered subscriptions/listen sent WITHOUT the extension declaration must each be rejected with -32021 (Missing Required Client Capability).
cases.error: check applies to the extension wire only

cases.title: TTL And Poll Interval Shapes
cases.description: Task TTL and poll interval use the era-native shapes: `ttlMs: number|null` / `pollIntervalMs` on the extension, `ttl` / `pollInterval` on the legacy wire.
cases.error: connection resolves to no tasks wire, so there is no task behavior to probe

cases.title: Completed Task Carries Its Result
cases.description: A completed task exposes its result the era-native way: inline on the extension's tasks/get, via tasks/result on the legacy wire.
cases.error: connection resolves to no tasks wire, so there is no task behavior to probe

cases.title: Mcp-Name Task Routing
cases.description: Over HTTP, tasks/get is sent with Mcp-Name set to the task id (captured off the fetch seam) and accepted by the server.
cases.error: Mcp-Name task routing applies to the extension wire only

cases.title: Invalid Task Id Rejected
cases.description: tasks/get for a task id the server never issued is rejected with -32602 (Invalid params); the same rejection on tasks/update and tasks/cancel is a SHOULD and is reported as advice.
cases.error: check applies to the extension wire only

cases.title: Status Payload Shape
cases.description: Each observed task status carries the payload its status requires: `result` on completed, `error` on failed, `inputRequests` on input_required.
cases.error: check applies to the extension wire only

cases.title: Cancel Acknowledged With An Empty Result
cases.description: tasks/cancel is acknowledged with an empty result rather than a task state, and the task's observable status is allowed to remain non-terminal afterwards.
cases.error: check applies to the extension wire only

cases.title: Update Acknowledged With An Empty Result
cases.description: tasks/update answering a task's input_required is acknowledged with an empty result carrying resultType "complete"; the task is not required to reach a terminal status afterwards.
cases.error: tasks/update is an extension-wire method

cases.title: TTL And Poll Interval Are Integers
cases.description: ttlMs and pollIntervalMs are integer milliseconds, as the extension's Task interface states.
cases.error: the integer-milliseconds statement belongs to the tasks extension; the legacy wire states no such bound

cases.title: Undeclared Capability Error Names What Is Missing
cases.description: A -32021 rejection carries error.data.requiredCapabilities naming the capability the client failed to declare.
cases.error: check applies to the extension wire only
